title: Paul's Distress in Asia and God's Deliverance
description: Paul tells the church in Corinth about extreme distress he experienced in Asia, where he was pressed far beyond his strength and lost hope of survival. He felt that a death sentence had been passed on him, but this happened so that he would not rely on himself, but on God who raises the dead. God delivered him, and Paul asks the church to help with intercession so that many may give thanks to God for the deliverance.
